items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I went to South America with Earl HInes and Oscar Peterson, doing some concert tours

ctx.x: And he said that -- he said that he looked good. He looked like his old self. He just had a few grey hairs in his

head, and he said that he felt pretty good. So later on, this must have been about 1966 or 7. Later on I went to South America with Earl HInes and Oscar Peterson, doing some concert tours, and I was in Brazil, and Booker was there in Brazil. And I went by to see him and he was staying with his stepdaughter's grandmamma, and she was taking care of him. He had cancer of the throat, and he said he had tried all kind of treatments.
